env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
mkdir $WORK/bin

# Cross-package const maps with named key and value types, a third-package
# value type, a same-named importer type, and a shadowed field name.
cd m
logos build -o $WORK/bin/qual$GOEXE ./app
exec $WORK/bin/qual$GOEXE
stdout '^ok origin-hit$'
stdout '^ok origin-miss$'
stdout '^ok color-hit$'
stdout '^ok color-miss$'
stdout '^ok key-hit$'
stdout '^ok third-hit$'
stdout '^ok len-const$'
stdout '^ok range-sorted$'
stdout '^ok copy-isolation$'
stdout '^ok field-shadow$'
stdout '^ok pkg-level$'
stdout '^ok holder-literal$'
cp stdout $WORK/want.txt
logos eject -o out
exists out/app/main.go
exists out/lib/lib.go
exists out/third/third.go
cd out
go run ./app
cmp stdout $WORK/want.txt
# SPEC 0.3: ejected output builds with upstream go1.27.2 from $UPROOT1272.
exists $UPROOT1272/bin/go
exec $UPROOT1272/bin/go version
stdout '^go version go1\.27\.2 '
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go build ./...
cd ..
cd ..

# An unexported named key type cannot be named in the importer.
cd badunexp
! logos build ./...
stderr 'cannot be named in this package'
cd ..

# An unexported field cannot be named in the importer.
cd badfield
! logos build ./...
stderr 'cannot be named in this package'
cd ..

# A nested unexported named type cannot be named in the importer.
cd badnested
! logos build ./...
stderr 'cannot be named in this package'
cd ..

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/cmqual

go 1.27

-- m/third/third.lgo --
package third

type Widget struct {
	N int
}

-- m/lib/lib.lgo --
package lib

import "example.com/cmqual/third"

type Color string
type Point struct {
	X int
	Y int
}

type Key struct {
	A int
	B int
}

type Holder struct {
	M const map[string]int
}

const Origin = map[string]Point{"o": {X: 0, Y: 0}, "z": {X: 1, Y: 1}}
const ByKey = map[Key]int{Key{A: 1, B: 2}: 10, Key{A: 3, B: 4}: 30}

const ByColor = map[Color]Point{
	"c00": {X: 0, Y: 0},
	"c01": {X: 1, Y: 1},
	"c02": {X: 2, Y: 4},
	"c03": {X: 3, Y: 9},
	"c04": {X: 4, Y: 16},
	"c05": {X: 5, Y: 25},
	"c06": {X: 6, Y: 36},
	"c07": {X: 7, Y: 49},
	"c08": {X: 8, Y: 64},
	"c09": {X: 9, Y: 81},
}

const Third = map[string]third.Widget{"a": {N: 1}}

const M = map[string]int{"a": 1}

func NewHolder() Holder {
	return Holder{M: map[string]int{"a": 2}}
}

-- m/app/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"os"

	"example.com/cmqual/lib"
)

type Point struct {
	X int
}

func fail(msg string) {
	fmt.Println("FAIL " + msg)
	os.Exit(1)
}

func checkOrigin() {
	if v, ok := lib.Origin["o"]; v.X != 0 || v.Y != 0 || !ok {
		fail("origin-hit")
	}
	fmt.Println("ok origin-hit")
	if _, ok := lib.Origin["zz"]; ok {
		fail("origin-miss")
	}
	fmt.Println("ok origin-miss")
}

func checkColor() {
	if v, ok := lib.ByColor["c04"]; v.X != 4 || v.Y != 16 || !ok {
		fail("color-hit")
	}
	fmt.Println("ok color-hit")
	if _, ok := lib.ByColor["zz"]; ok {
		fail("color-miss")
	}
	fmt.Println("ok color-miss")
}

func checkKeys() {
	if v, ok := lib.ByKey[lib.Key{A: 1, B: 2}]; v != 10 || !ok {
		fail("key-hit")
	}
	fmt.Println("ok key-hit")
	if v, ok := lib.Third["a"]; v.N != 1 || !ok {
		fail("third-hit")
	}
	fmt.Println("ok third-hit")
	if len(lib.Origin) != 2 || len(lib.ByColor) != 10 || len(lib.ByKey) != 2 || len(lib.Third) != 1 {
		fail("len-const")
	}
	fmt.Println("ok len-const")
}

func checkRange() {
	keys := ""
	sum := 0
	n := 0
	for k, v := range lib.ByColor {
		keys += string(k) + ";"
		sum += v.X + v.Y
		n++
	}
	if keys != "c00;c01;c02;c03;c04;c05;c06;c07;c08;c09;" || sum != 330 || n != 10 {
		fail("range-sorted")
	}
	fmt.Println("ok range-sorted")
}

func checkCopy() {
	copied := lib.Origin
	copied["o"] = lib.Point{X: 9, Y: 9}
	if v, ok := lib.Origin["o"]; v.X != 0 || v.Y != 0 || !ok {
		fail("copy-isolation")
	}
	fmt.Println("ok copy-isolation")
}

func checkShadow() {
	h := lib.NewHolder()
	if v, ok := h.M["a"]; v != 2 || !ok {
		fail("field-shadow")
	}
	fmt.Println("ok field-shadow")
	if v, ok := lib.M["a"]; v != 1 || !ok {
		fail("pkg-level")
	}
	fmt.Println("ok pkg-level")
	h2 := lib.Holder{M: map[string]int{"a": 5}}
	if v, ok := h2.M["a"]; v != 5 || !ok {
		fail("holder-literal")
	}
	fmt.Println("ok holder-literal")
}

func main() {
	checkOrigin()
	checkColor()
	checkKeys()
	checkRange()
	checkCopy()
	checkShadow()
}

-- badunexp/go.mod --
module example.com/cmbadunexp

go 1.27

-- badunexp/lib/lib.lgo --
package lib

type secret string

const K = map[secret]int{"a": 1}

-- badunexp/app/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/cmbadunexp/lib"
)

func main() {
	if v, ok := lib.K["a"]; ok {
		fmt.Println(v)
	}
}

-- badfield/go.mod --
module example.com/cmbadfield

go 1.27

-- badfield/lib/lib.lgo --
package lib

type Holder struct {
	hidden int
	Shown  int
}

const H = map[string]Holder{"a": {hidden: 1, Shown: 2}}

-- badfield/app/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/cmbadfield/lib"
)

func main() {
	if v, ok := lib.H["a"]; ok {
		fmt.Println(v.Shown)
	}
}

-- badnested/go.mod --
module example.com/cmbadnested

go 1.27

-- badnested/lib/lib.lgo --
package lib

type inner struct {
	V int
}

type Outer struct {
	In inner
	N  int
}

const O = map[string]Outer{"a": {In: inner{V: 1}, N: 2}}

-- badnested/app/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/cmbadnested/lib"
)

func main() {
	if v, ok := lib.O["a"]; ok {
		fmt.Println(v.N)
	}
}
